_meta.purpose: Multi-theme universe registry (docs/multi_theme_expansion.md Phase 1). Each theme defines its ETF holdings sources, bucket name, benchmark ETF basket (for the future theme_link engine's market-link component) and disclosure keyword groups (for the disclosure component). Phase 1 uses sources + bucket only; keywords/benchmarks are pre-registered for Phase 2.
_meta.note_on_overlap: nuclear and copper/metals ETFs (URA/NLR/COPX/PICK) are ALREADY watchlist sources via the ai_enabler/ai_peripheral AI-adjacent lens; the theme buckets give them first-class identity instead of AI-narrative leakage.

nuclear.notes: 核电/铀矿/核服务。已有 AI 副叙事泄漏（CEG/BWXT/CCJ），主题化后主题分将高于 ai_link 分

quantum.notes: QTUM 是唯一成熟纯量子 ETF；ARKQ 已在 AI core 篮子中提供量子泄漏

biotech.notes: 盈利型药企（PPH）与研发型 biotech（XBI/IBB）混合。Phase 2 需要行业专化质量维度（管线阶段替代部分财务质量）——临床前公司会被现行质量门槛排斥

rare_earth.notes: 稀土磁材链（永磁体=机器人/风电/军工的关键瓶颈）

critical_minerals.notes: 电池金属+铜。COPX/PICK 已在 AI peripheral 篮子里（铜=AI 电网）——主题化后按自有叙事打分
